ai.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei responds: doesn’t oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
ai.brief: S. government to ban open-weight Chinese models, or possibly open-weight models generally. “Anyone who has read my past writing should know that I don’t regard such bans as a useful measure, but let me state it clearly so that there is no doubt: Anthropic has never advocated for a ban on open-weights models ,” he wrote, emphasis his own. His response came after Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang took to X ( his first post on the platform) to share an open letter on Friday in which Nvidia and a long list of other AI companies including Hugging Face, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral, and Nvidia urged policymakers not to impose broad “premature restrictions” on open-weight AI models.
